title.narrative: Provision of life-saving nutrition interventions to reduce morbidity and mortality among women and children in at-risk Local Government Areas with famine-like situations in NE Nigeria.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide nutrition assistance to the most vulnerable communities affected by food insecurity and malnutrition in Nigeria. The project screens and treats children suffering from severe acute malnutrition. It also provides training to caregivers on Maternal, Infant, and Young Child Nutrition, and strengthens early warning systems. This project provides humanitarian assistance to 79,500 people, including 60,000 women, 15,000 children, and 2,371 persons with disabilities.
